Title: Manoj's Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 31 years, son
Look: moustache, checked shirt
2. Sonali - 28 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Anil - 30 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Anjali - 25 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Hema - 61 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Manoj stands by the road. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Let's do something fun today."

[Manoj rides his motorbike to the market.]

Manoj: "Yes, all right."

[Manoj drives the car to the office.]

Sonali: "Let's see."

[Manoj gets out of the car.]

Manoj: "That was such a fun day!"
